body.title: Plugin: additive heading-id hook in the bundled markdown-renderer.js
body.summary: Additively extend the S002 bundled markdown-renderer.js so ATX headings emit a stable id (slug + ordinal) and expose the heading path, enabling CommentAnchor.sectionPath. Purely additive to the render output; the HTML-escaping, link-scheme filter, and CSP (no CDN, read-only) rules are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Headings render with a stable, unique id (slug + ordinal for duplicates); a heading-path helper is available to the comment JS.
No change to escaping / link-scheme / CSP behavior; still a local resource (no CDN).
The renderer still ships in the plugin jar; S002 rendering is unaffected.

tests.name: renderer resource: the bundled markdown-renderer.js still ships in the built resources / jar and carries no http(s)/CDN reference after the heading-id addition
